decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed single storey side extension, by reason of its size, position and appearance in this prominent location would represent an incongruous and obtrusive feature, resulting in a loss of balance out of character with the existing terrace dwelling houses detrimental to the appearance of the streetscene, contrary to Adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV.1.1, H.3.4 and Revised Deposit Policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4. (January 2001) and the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed single storey side extension would, by reason of its position, size and appearance, have a significant adverse impact on the outlook of the adjoining neighbours, detrimental to the amenities currently enjoyed by the adjoining neighbours. The proposal is contrary to Adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV.1.1, H.3.4 and Revised Deposit Policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4 and the Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a single storey side extension to single family dwellinghouse.
